about_the_game:
🐾 Cat Summoner - Block Puzzle -

A single spark of insight can open the path.
Experience that moment — 135 times.

📝 About the Game

Guide the ice blocks onto the switches.

Cat Summoner is a thoughtful puzzle game where you move ice blocks
with a little help from some magical cats—across 135 handcrafted stages.

Each level features not only ice blocks, but various other block types.
Combine their unique behaviors to find the path forward and solve the puzzle.

Some stages may look complex at first, but with a bit of intuition, the solution can appear in a flash.
Enjoy the quiet sense of accomplishment that comes with every breakthrough.

🔍 Features

  • 2D top-down puzzle gameplay focused on logic and strategy

  • Three difficulty tiers: beginner, intermediate, and advanced

  • Summoned cats bring a touch of playful flair to each puzzle

  • Relaxing background music helps you focus in peace

  • No time limits, no action—just pure thinking

  • Stuck? The hint cat is always there to help

🐈 Meet the Summoned Cats

Even when the path seems blocked, these cats can shift the flow with a single strike.
Their little animations bring charm and joy to every puzzle.

  • Orlen Fayu – Clears the way with a quick one-two punch

  • Grita Vonn – Crushes obstacles with a heavy heel drop

  • Veshti Aer – Light-footed flurry stomps to open new paths

  • Thanieth Oru – A clever mage with a cat toy staff who offers helpful hints

※ New feline friends will join your journey as you progress through the game.

🗺 World & Stage Structure

The game takes place among floating ruins high above the once-lush “Grasslands.”
To rekindle life in this long-lost world, the cat summoner Airi Tex moves blocks, one by one.

As you solve each puzzle, you’ll see subtle changes in the ruined land.
Watch as the world slowly breathes life again—a quiet story of restoration woven into your progress.

  • Restore three regions of the Grasslands (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)

  • 15 stages per level × 9 areas = 135 stages total

  • Each cleared stage helps the desolate world come back to life
